description: This Java class 'GridFactory' provides methods for loading, caching, and creating 'ModelGrid' objects from XML definitions for a widget system within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionality for fetching grid configurations from file locations, web app context, and parsing XML documents to generate grid models.

classes.name: GridFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading, caching, and constructing grid models for the widget system from XML configurations in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getGridsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads all grid models defined in an XML document located at the given resource name, caching them for future use.

methods.name: getGridFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific grid model by name from an XML resource location, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getGridFromWebappContext
methods.description: Gets a grid model by name from the web application context, considering the current theme and request, with caching.

methods.name: readGridDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to extract and create a map of grid models for each grid element found.

methods.name: createModelGrid
methods.description: Creates a ModelGrid object either from an XML Document or Element, associating it with relevant context and configuration.
